## Serving and the model

In vLLM on the same card, the 0.8B answers **`{python} serve["one_at_a_time"]` faster** than the 2B
one request at a time, and serves **`{python} serve["batched"]` cheaper** with every test-clean
prompt batched. The headline model is B at step `{python} story.facts("B")["step"]`, a LoRA adapter
on the 0.8B; its release on the Hugging Face Hub is [#96]({{< var repo >}}/issues/96).
